schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The database schema being edited, as the editor holds it.

values.title: Values
values.description: The form's fields by key: server, port, database, options.

user.title: User
user.description: The database user, when the connection logs in with one.

password.title: Password
password.description: The user's password. Used for this call only.

project_guid.title: Project Guid
project_guid.description: The project whose variables ${project:name} references in the values, user and password are filled in from - a secret one in the password only. Without one, a reference is refused.

connection.title: DbConnection
connection.description: A connection as the Schema Editor's form has it (get_db_connection_form).

table.title: Table
table.description: The table to read, matched regardless of case.

replace.title: Replace
replace.description: Replace the schema's table of the same name, keeping its description and code sets.
